classPrimeCountStream{conststd::vector<std::int64_t>&primes;std::vector<std::int64_t>nextOddMultiple;std::vector<unsignedchar>sieve;std::int64_tmaximum;std::int64_tlow;std::int64_tcount;std::int64_toffset=0;std::int64_tlength=0;voidfill(){low+=2*length;length=std::min<std::int64_t>(sieve.size(),(maximum-low)/2+1);std::fill(sieve.begin(),sieve.begin()+length,1);conststd::int64_thigh=low+2*(length-1);for(std::size_ti=2;i<nextOddMultiple.size();++i){conststd::int64_tp=primes[i];if(p>(high/p)){break;}std::int64_tj=(nextOddMultiple[i]-low)/2;for(;j<length;j+=p){sieve[j]=0;}nextOddMultiple[i]=low+2*j;}offset=0;}public:PrimeCountStream(std::int64_tstart,std::int64_tfinish,std::int64_tpiStart,constPhiTables&tables):primes(tables.primes()),nextOddMultiple(tables.pi()[IntegerSqrt(finish)]+1),sieve(std::max<std::size_t>(32768,IntegerSqrt(finish))),maximum(finish),low(start+1),count(piStart){if(low%2==0){++low;}for(std::size_ti=2;i<nextOddMultiple.size();++i){conststd::int64_tp=primes[i];std::int64_tfirst=std::max(p*p,low+(p-low%p)%p);if(first%2==0){first+=p;}nextOddMultiple[i]=first;}}std::int64_tcountTo(std::int64_ttarget){while(low+2*offset<=target){if(offset==length){fill();}conststd::size_tstop=std::min<std::size_t>(length,(target-low)/2+1);count=std::accumulate(sieve.begin()+offset,sieve.begin()+stop,count);offset=stop;}returncount;}}
